name: On Edit
description: Checks edited files for silent errors, console.log usage, and implicit any

then.prompt:
A file was edited. Please verify:
1. No new TODO comments without a corresponding task file in tasks/
2. All catch blocks log the error (no silent failures — this is a bug)
3. No console.log statements (use winston logger from @a2a/server-utils in server code)
4. No implicit any — types must be explicit
5. If a public interface changed, check if the corresponding docs in docs/ need updating
Report any violations found.
